description: Traffic to pollinations.ai and enter.pollinations.ai: Cloudflare arrivals for both sites, first-party page views, visitor sources and sign-in and purchase funnels from product_event, and Google Search. Each source covers different traffic and dates; see Data coverage.

panels.title: Arrivals · Cloudflare visits, sampled estimate (both sites)

panels.description: How many arrivals each site gets per day. Arrivals are Cloudflare's visits metric: a sampled estimate of page loads that arrive from another site or are typed in, not every page load (revalidated 304 loads and in-app navigation are never counted). Cloudflare page_views stores only our own page routes (the pollinations.ai page routes and Enter's routes), which on pollinations.ai is only about 10% of browser HTML loads; other paths, such as old prompt URLs, are not stored. Latest fetch per UTC day, HTML status 200, browsers only (verified bots and Unknown, curl, wget, headless Chrome and *Bot user agents excluded). Cloudflare history starts 29 Aug 2026, so a 90-day range is partial.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  latest AS (
    -- A rerun appends the same day again: keep the latest fetch per day.
    SELECT date, argMax(body, fetched_at) AS body
    FROM cloudflare_traffic_raw
    WHERE dataset = 'page_views' AND $__dateFilter(date)
    GROUP BY date
  ),
  groups AS (
    SELECT
      date,
      if(JSONExtractString(g, 'dimensions', 'clientRequestHTTPHost') = 'enter.pollinations.ai', 'enter', 'website') AS site,
      JSONExtractString(g, 'dimensions', 'clientRequestPath') AS path,
      JSONExtractString(g, 'dimensions', 'clientCountryName') AS country,
      JSONExtractString(g, 'dimensions', 'clientDeviceType') = 'mobile' AS mobile,
      JSONExtractString(g, 'dimensions', 'userAgentBrowser') AS browser,
      -- Already scaled for sampling by Cloudflare: never multiply by sampleInterval.
      JSONExtractUInt(g, 'sum', 'visits') AS visits
    FROM latest
    ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractArrayRaw(body, 'data', 'viewer', 'zones', 1, 'httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups') AS g
    WHERE JSONExtractUInt(g, 'dimensions', 'edgeResponseStatus') = 200
      AND JSONExtractString(g, 'dimensions', 'verifiedBotCategory') = ''
  )
SELECT
  b.1 AS breakdown,
  toDateTime(if(b.1 = 'day', date, toDate(0))) AS time,
  b.2 AS key,
  sumIf(visits, site = 'website') AS website,
  round(sumIf(visits, site = 'website' AND mobile) / nullIf(website, 0), 3) AS website_mobile,
  sumIf(visits, site = 'enter') AS enter,
  round(sumIf(visits, site = 'enter' AND mobile) / nullIf(enter, 0), 3) AS enter_mobile
FROM groups
ARRAY JOIN [('day', ''), ('page', path), ('country', country)] AS b
-- Browsers only: scripts, headless Chrome and self-declared crawlers are not visitors.
WHERE browser NOT IN ('Unknown', 'Curl', 'Wget', 'ChromeHeadless')
  AND NOT endsWith(browser, 'Bot')
GROUP BY breakdown, time, key
ORDER BY breakdown, time, website + enter DESC

First-party · Enter since 18 Sep 2026, pollinations.ai after #16991

panels.description: Every pollinations.ai page view by route, including in-app navigation, recorded by Enter as product_event website_page_viewed. Shows No data until #16991 ships (Enter first) and website deploys resume. No cookie or browser id: views, not people. Not comparable with Cloudflare arrivals, which count only loads arriving from outside. product_event starts 18 Sep 2026, so a 90-day range is partial.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS time,
  toString(page) AS page,
  count() AS views
FROM product_event
WHERE environment = 'production'
  AND event = 'website_page_viewed'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, page
ORDER BY time

panels.title: pollinations.ai page views per day

panels.description: Every page view per site and route, including in-app navigation, from product_event (page_viewed for Enter, website_page_viewed for pollinations.ai, so Enter's / is never the website home). pollinations.ai rows appear once website page views exist. Signed-in people are distinct accounts; signed-out views have no identity. Older Enter rows recorded /_dashboard/... and are merged into the real path. product_event starts 18 Sep 2026, so a 90-day range is partial.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  if(event = 'website_page_viewed', 'pollinations.ai', 'enter.pollinations.ai') AS site,
  -- Enter recorded route ids (/_dashboard/news) before it recorded real paths.
  replaceRegexpOne(page, '^/_dashboard(/|$)', '/') AS path,
  count() AS views,
  countIf(user_id = '') AS signed_out_views,
  uniqIf(user_id, user_id != '') AS signed_in_people
FROM product_event
WHERE environment = 'production'
  AND event IN ('page_viewed', 'website_page_viewed')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY site, path
ORDER BY views DESC

panels.title: Pages viewed

panels.description: Source = campaign tag (utm_source or ?ref=), else referring host, else direct. Views count every page view by its own source; the pollinations.ai views column stays blank until website page views exist. People and signups are first touch: each signed-in person counted once, on the source of their earliest Enter view in the range, so rows add up. Signups via pollinations.ai = that first view was referred by the website. Attribution shifts twice: when Enter deploys #16991, landing utm tags survive Enter's redirects; when website v2 deploys, links to Enter carry the visitor's own source, so website-referred signups move from the pollinations.ai row to that source while Signups via pollinations.ai still counts them. product_event starts 18 Sep 2026, so a 90-day range is partial.

targets.rawSql:
-- Keep the top 40 sources of each site, so website-heavy sources stay visible.
SELECT source, website_views, enter_views, people, signups, signups_via_website
FROM (
  SELECT
    *,
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY people DESC, enter_views DESC) AS enter_rank,
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ifNull(website_views, 0) DESC) AS website_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT
      source,
      nullIf(countIf(event = 'website_page_viewed'), 0) AS website_views,
      countIf(event = 'page_viewed') AS enter_views,
      countIf(first_touch) AS people,
      countIf(first_touch AND signed_up) AS signups,
      countIf(first_touch AND signed_up AND via_website) AS signups_via_website
    FROM (
      SELECT
        event,
        -- Campaign tag (or ?ref=) first, else the referring host. Agent links
        -- sometimes carry markdown leftovers after the tag: cut at ) ] , or space.
        multiIf(
          utm_source != '', replaceRegexpOne(utm_source, '[)\\],\\s].*$', ''),
          referrer_host != '', referrer_host,
          'direct'
        ) AS source,
        referrer_host IN ('pollinations.ai', 'www.pollinations.ai') AS via_website,
        -- First touch: the earliest signed-in Enter view of each person in the range.
        user_id != ''
          AND event = 'page_viewed'
          AND row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, event ORDER BY timestamp) = 1 AS first_touch,
        max(event = 'signup_completed') OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS signed_up
      FROM product_event
      WHERE environment = 'production'
        AND event IN ('page_viewed', 'website_page_viewed', 'signup_completed')
        AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    )
    WHERE event != 'signup_completed'
    GROUP BY source
  )
)
WHERE enter_rank <= 40 OR (website_rank <= 40 AND website_views > 0)
ORDER BY people DESC, enter_views DESC

panels.title: Where visitors come from

panels.description: GitHub sign-ins in the range: sent to GitHub, came back with a code, session created, and of those a new account. Plain counts, so a retry counts again (same stages as the auth_flow_funnel endpoint). Percentages are of the first stage. product_event starts 18 Sep 2026, so a 90-day range is partial.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  funnel,
  concat(step, ' (', ifNull(toString(round(100 * n / nullIf(first_value(n) OVER (PARTITION BY funnel ORDER BY step), 0))), '0'), '%)') AS stage,
  n AS count
FROM (
  SELECT
    -- Browser sign-in: plain counts, a retry counts again (auth_flow_funnel).
    countIf(event = 'sign_in_started') AS started,
    countIf(event = 'sign_in_returned') AS returned,
    countIf(event = 'sign_in_completed') AS completed,
    countIf(event = 'signup_completed') AS signups,
    -- CLI device sign-in: one count per device row, so a retried stage is not double counted.
    uniqIf(flow_id, event = 'device_code_issued') AS codes,
    uniqIf(flow_id, event = 'device_approved') AS approved,
    uniqIf(flow_id, event = 'device_token_issued') AS tokens,
    -- Purchase: distinct signed-in people.
    uniqIf(user_id, event = 'page_viewed' AND user_id != '' AND page IN ('/pollen', '/top-up', '/_dashboard/pollen')) AS viewed_pollen,
    uniqIf(user_id, event = 'checkout_started') AS checkout,
    uniqIf(
      user_id,
      event = 'checkout_started'
      AND user_id IN (
        SELECT user_id
        FROM stripe_event
        WHERE livemode = 1
          AND payment_status = 'paid'
          AND event_type IN ('checkout.session.completed', 'checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded')
          AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      )
    ) AS paid
  FROM product_event
  WHERE environment = 'production'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND event IN (
      'sign_in_started', 'sign_in_returned', 'sign_in_completed', 'signup_completed',
      'device_code_issued', 'device_approved', 'device_token_issued',
      'page_viewed', 'checkout_started'
    )
)
ARRAY JOIN
  ['sign_in', 'sign_in', 'sign_in', 'sign_in', 'cli', 'cli', 'cli', 'purchase', 'purchase', 'purchase'] AS funnel,
  ['1 · Sent to GitHub', '2 · Back from GitHub', '3 · Signed in', '4 · New account',
   '1 · Code shown in CLI', '2 · Approved in browser', '3 · Token collected',
   '1 · Viewed Pollen or top-up page', '2 · Started checkout', '3 · Paid'] AS step,
  [started, returned, completed, signups, codes, approved, tokens, viewed_pollen, checkout, paid] AS n
ORDER BY funnel, step

panels.description: Google web search for every pollinations.ai host, latest fetch per day. Days are Pacific time and Google publishes them 3-4 days late, so the last days are always missing. Totals include queries Google hides from the query list.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  latest AS (
    SELECT dataset, date, argMax(body, fetched_at) AS body
    FROM search_console_raw
    WHERE $__dateFilter(date)
    GROUP BY dataset, date, start_row
  ),
  parsed AS (
    SELECT
      multiIf(dataset = 'totals', 'day', dataset = 'queries', 'query', 'page') AS breakdown,
      toDateTime(if(dataset = 'totals', date, toDate(0))) AS time,
      if(dataset = 'totals', '', replaceRegexpOne(JSONExtractString(r, 'keys', 1), '^https://', '')) AS key,
      JSONExtractUInt(r, 'clicks') AS row_clicks,
      JSONExtractUInt(r, 'impressions') AS row_impressions,
      JSONExtractFloat(r, 'position') AS row_position
    FROM latest
    ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractArrayRaw(body, 'rows') AS r
  )
SELECT
  breakdown,
  time,
  key,
  sum(row_clicks) AS clicks,
  sum(row_impressions) AS impressions,
  round(clicks / nullIf(impressions, 0), 4) AS ctr,
  round(sum(row_position * row_impressions) / nullIf(impressions, 0), 1) AS position
FROM parsed
GROUP BY breakdown, time, key
ORDER BY breakdown, time, clicks DESC, impressions DESC
LIMIT 100 BY breakdown, time

options.content:
### Sources and limits

- **Range:** the last 30 complete UTC days by default, 7 or 90 from the header; yesterday is the latest day
- **Cloudflare arrivals** `cloudflare_traffic_raw` page_views, from 29 Aug 2026 (a 90-day range is partial): Cloudflare's visits metric, a sampled estimate of loads arriving from another site or typed in, not page loads; browsers only. page_views stores only our own page routes (the pollinations.ai page routes and Enter's routes), which on pollinations.ai is only about 10% of browser HTML loads; other paths, such as old prompt URLs, are not stored
- **First-party** `product_event`: starts 18–19 Sep 2026, so a 90-day range, and the 30-day default until 19 Oct, holds fewer days of it. pollinations.ai page views (`website_page_viewed`) appear only after #16991 ships and website deploys resume. No cookie or browser id, so signed-out activity is views, not people
- **Attribution shifts on two dates:** when Enter deploys #16991, landing utm tags survive Enter's redirects; when website v2 deploys, links to Enter carry the visitor's source
- **Google** `search_console_raw`: Pacific-time days, published 3–4 days late
- **Not here:** registrations and balances (Users & Balances), revenue and costs (Economics)
